name: rngui
description: Monorepo for native reusable React Native UI components.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:kotlin --workspaces --if-present
scripts.gen: npm run gen:swift-types --workspaces --if-present && npm run gen:kotlin-types --workspaces --if-present && npm run gen:material-symbols --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:swift-types --workspaces --if-present && npm run verify:kotlin-types --workspaces --if-present && npm run verify:material-symbols --workspaces --if-present && npm run test
